intro.text: A member of the crew of the pirate ship Crow's Song.
A crew member of the Crow's Song whose name really is Doug, unlike the many sailors the story simply calls Doug.

items.text: Doug was busy sewing the ship's pirate flag when the Crow's Song attacked the Oot's Dream. The flag was finished in time for a raid on a merchant ship, and when Doug ran it up at Crow's order, the merchant surrendered.
